optIn.toggleLabel: Also share with HURIA (Human Rights Agenda), SafeRide's partner on the Coast
optIn.toggleHint: Off unless you turn it on. SafeRide gets your report either way.
optIn.referralOnlyForPartner: This option appears only when you pick HURIA as your provider.

consent.title: What sharing with HURIA means
consent.escalationSees: Named HURIA staff will see this report in their secure SafeRide dashboard as the packet you prepared, at the redaction level you chose ({redactionLevel}): what happened and your statement, any impact or witness details you added, the time, the place in words, your tags and any vehicle details, your alias if you chose one, and the list of your evidence, including your descriptions and transcripts of any recordings (with the masking you chose), but not the files themselves. They never see your exact map coordinates.
consent.referralSees: Named HURIA staff will see the same reviewed report packet used for escalation, shown below at the selected masking level ({redactionLevel}). When support details are on, it includes what happened, your statement, any impact or witness details, time and place in words, tags, vehicle details and any chosen alias, plus evidence descriptions and transcripts. If support details are off, the packet contains no report details or evidence list. HURIA never sees your exact map coordinates. Evidence files are not shared.
consent.notShared: SafeRide does not send HURIA the phone number or email of your SafeRide account. HURIA gets a phone number only if you choose to add a callback number below. Evidence files (photos, audio, video and documents) are not shared with HURIA yet.
consent.withdraw: You can stop sharing at any time from this case or from Privacy & data. HURIA then loses access to this report straight away. Anything HURIA has already done, such as calling you or referring you onward, cannot be undone.
consent.reference: After you send, you get a reference number. HURIA is the digital recipient for both support referrals and escalations. HURIA can coordinate onward support with police, health services or other providers; SafeRide does not send this packet directly to those organisations. To talk to HURIA, call 0769 546 253 and quote your reference. HURIA calls you only if you choose to share a callback number.

callback.toggleHint: Off unless you turn it on. Without it, you call HURIA yourself and quote your reference.
callback.inputLabel: Kenyan mobile number HURIA can call
callback.invalidNumber: Enter a Kenyan mobile number, for example 0712 345 678.
callback.body: HURIA staff may call you on this number about this report. Authorised HURIA caseworkers can see it, and every time someone views it, that view is logged. If you stop sharing, the number is removed.
callback.safetyTip: Safety tip: only share a number that is safe for you to be called on. If someone else might answer or check this phone, leave this off and call HURIA yourself.

HURIA will lose access to all your reports straight away, and any callback number you shared will be removed. SafeRide keeps your reports. Anything HURIA has already done cannot be undone.
